NoSQLServer v0.30 validation
============================
Runtime: ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 (64-bit Linux)

New window surface
------------------
PASS: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)
PASS: RANK() peer semantics
PASS: DENSE_RANK() peer semantics
PASS: global ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ...) with no PARTITION BY
PASS: DESC window ordering
PASS: running COUNT(*) with explicit ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING..CURRENT ROW
PASS: running AVG(column)
PASS: running MIN(column)
PASS: running MAX(column)
PASS: partition-local state reset
PASS: existing v0.28 running SUM remains compatible

Runtime regression
------------------
PASS: historical smoke chain from native storage through v0.29
PASS: v0.30 extended window smoke
PASS: Claude torture scorer 12/12, 0 wrong results
PASS: Grok feature torture 72/72
PASS: SQL-92 company smoke
PASS: Grok hell corpus 24/25, 0 wrong results (Q23 remains deliberate unsupported semantic edge)
PASS: rexxc src/NoSQLServer.cls
PASS: rexxc tests/*.rex

Deliberate boundaries
---------------------
- Running aggregate windows require explicit ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
- Multiple window expressions in one SELECT must currently share partition/order/direction.
- Arbitrary ROWS/RANGE frames, LEAD/LAG, FIRST_VALUE/LAST_VALUE, NTILE, and general multi-window planning are not yet claimed.
